projects.title: LED Roadway Lighting
projects.summary: Developing full-stack software solutions and deploying edge-AI technology for smart city infrastructure.
keyContributions: Engineered a full-stack lighting simulation platform using Python (Flask) and vanilla JavaScript, integrating the Radiance engine to perform complex raytracing and light calculations for internal and customer use.
Deployed AI-driven computer vision models onto smart camera hardware to enable real-time intrusion detection and detailed roadway statistical analysis.
Processed live data streams to validate deep learning model performance and ensure high model accuracy, using Python and Microsoft Excel for rigorous data analytics and QA.
Designed and maintained REST APIs to bridge heavy computational backend scripts and frontend interfaces, ensuring seamless data flow for simulation tools.

projects.title: DEEBug — AI Debugging Tool
projects.summary: A web-based tool designed to detect and fix performance bugs in deep learning models, featuring a modular ML pipeline with an in-browser code editor and AI-powered result analysis.
keyContributions: Built modular, reusable front-end components using React, React Router, and Tailwind CSS for the core ML pipeline (data prep, model definition, training, evaluation, and visualization).
Implemented UI/UX for a modular code redesign, allowing users to write Python scripts directly into a web-based code editor.
Contributed to a full-stack system where a React front-end communicates with a Python/Flask backend API.
Integrated backend systems that assemble and execute Python code, analyze results with the Gemini API, and display TensorFlow visualizations.

projects.title: Full-Stack Webmail Client
projects.summary: Designed, built, and deployed a full-stack web application from scratch — a complete email client with user authentication, inbox/sent management, and email composition.
keyContributions: Engineered a RESTful API using Node.js and Express to handle all user and email operations.
Implemented a complete user authentication system using Express Sessions and crypto for secure SHA-256 password hashing and verification.
Designed and managed a MySQL database schema for users, login credentials, and email storage.
Developed a responsive, multi-page front-end with HTML, Bootstrap, and vanilla JavaScript for composing email, viewing inbox/sent, and user registration.

projects.title: Hotel Web Booking Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack web application for browsing and booking hotel rooms, built on a custom file-based database with zero third-party frameworks on the backend.
keyContributions: Built a custom backend server from scratch using the native Node.js http module (no framework) to handle all routing.
Engineered a custom REST API (/api/rooms) serving room data from a JSON file-based database.
Implemented server-side business logic for date conflict validation and real-time room availability checks using the fs module.
Developed a responsive front-end using vanilla JavaScript to consume the API and handle booking forms.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.summary: This site. A multi-page portfolio with a React frontend, serverless backend, and a liquid-glass UI — deployed across AWS Amplify and Netlify Functions.
keyContributions: Built a responsive React frontend with React Router, a custom liquid-glass design system, and smooth scroll-reveal animations.
Engineered a serverless backend using Netlify Functions (Node.js) to serve project and skill data via a REST API.
Integrated the OpenWeatherMap API with secure environment variable management.
Deployed to AWS Amplify with a CI/CD pipeline connected to GitHub.
